Tech capture guidance:
- Primary: Redwood will capture via the webinar Zoom link (we provide an RTMP/OBS bridge if you want higher fidelity).
- Backup: please record locally (screen + voice) and upload to the Drive folder below within 4 hours of the session. Local recording is purely a safety net for clipping.
- If your demo uses audio from another machine (e.g., a VM), you _must_ enable system audio in the Zoom share or provide a loopback.
- Set your machine to power-saver OFF and close heavy apps; we recommend running the demo on a wired network.

Slides and media:
- Slide deadline: 72 hours before the event — deadline is 2026-11-15T11:59:00-08:00.
- Filename convention: [YYYYMMDD]-Epoch-[PresenterLastName]-slides.pptx (example: 20261115-Epoch-Collins-slides.pptx).
- Template: attached (slide-template.pptx). Avoid embedded fonts; export any video snippets as MP4 (H.264).

Uploads / links:
- Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aBcDef-Redwood-Webinar-Nov18
- Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210

AV vendor and day-of contacts:

- I'll run a 20-minute dry run slot on Nov 16; can you confirm availability?
